description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans cluster health monitoring system, specifically testing the ClusterHealthMonitor and SiloHealthMonitor components within the NonSilo project. The tests verify silos' health detection, monitoring, and failure declaration mechanisms, including scenarios with stale silos, indirect probing, and vote-based death declaration.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitorTests
classes.description: Test class for the Orleans cluster health monitoring system, implementing various test scenarios for cluster and silo health detection and failure declaration.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_BasicScenario
methods.description: Runs a basic scenario test for ClusterHealthMonitor and SiloHealthMonitor, verifying health probes and failure detection.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_MonitorAllStaleSilos
methods.description: Tests monitoring behavior when all silos are considered stale.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_NoIndirectProbes
methods.description: Verifies monitoring with indirect probes disabled.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_ThreeVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests killing silos after three votes.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_OneVoteNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests killing silos after one vote.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_OneVoteNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests handling of stale created or joining silos with one vote needed for clocking out.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_TwoVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests handling of stale created or joining silos with two votes needed.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_ThreeVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Tests handling of stale created or joining silos with three votes needed.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_SilosWithStaleCreatedOrJoiningState_Disabled
methods.description: Tests handling when eviction for stale join/create states is disabled.
